a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show all content; dist/index.html has 3px var(--focus) outline at 3px offset, forced-colors block, labelled inputs, one h1 and clean h2>h3 order; render.json clean. motion.notes: 1440-scroll-50.jpg: margin plan ticks findings with '4 of 7 read' and a drawn leader from the finding rule into the plate's red circle; red-pen draw-ons, estimator redraw by roof shape (1440-scroll-25.jpg), hero spread settle; many hooks in dist/index.html (split, stagger, estimator, hotspot, dock, mobilebar, lightbox). wow.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: count sheet redraws the plan with eave dimension lines and shows the roofer's math to 28–31 squares with a Sample price band, linked to the ticking margin plan and the signed-off footer plan (1440-full.jpg). The tool's plan carries no pins and a stray '29.8 sq' competes with the result, so it is not yet one designed report page.

polish.notes: SVG favicon, apple-touch, OG, RoofingContractor JSON-LD, print styles, one radius, designed footer close with ticked plan (1440-full.jpg footer); no transition: all. Coral price figures and pins in the graphite prices band are off-palette (1440-full.jpg ~65%).

elevate.move: Turn the type into the printed report: one mono voice only for report furniture (F-numbers, sheet headers, figures), everything else in Public Sans sentence case including field keys and eyebrows folded into the heading line, timeline at a readable 15px, and one big tight display figure per band (28–31 squares, 32.3 sq, $12,000–$21,000) so a text-only screenshot reads as an inspector's report.

Make the evidence plates a sequence, not a set: F-01 roof from the street, F-02 stain inside, F-03 chalk line on deck, F-04 hail square, F-05 soft decking, F-06 magnet in the yard, F-07 finished ridge, with one paper border, tab and caption grammar, and the wide break plate as the finished roof with all seven pins ticked, so the page reads as one inspection shot in order and real photos drop into the same frames later.
